newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle Monday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle Monday roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was inactive in the Panhandle area Monday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers not tested. Feedlots reporting good inquiry from buyers.
Confirmed - None Last week - 5,300 Year Ago - 39,200
WK to date - 30,200 Last week - 5,500 Year Ago - 54,500
There were 30,200 head confirmed for week to date which includes 29,900 head formulated and 300 head previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
The last established price was $63.00 per cwt on Thursday.
Tuesday's packer bids were $62.00-$63.00, with asking prices $64.00-$65.00. Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
